UNCONFIRMED ALIAS TARGET. The pricing page does not mention gemini-flash-latest, and the models page only describes 'latest' aliases generally. The release notes (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog) last record the alias as moved on 2026-05-19 to gemini-3.5-flash; on 2026-10-08 they say gemini-3.5-flash is deprecated and its requests are routed to gemini-3.6-flash, and gemini-3.8-flash is the newest Flash model. No entry states the alias's target after that, so it is one of gemini-3.6-flash or gemini-3.8-flash; the pricing page gives both the identical price used here (paid tier, Standard, per 1M tokens): input 0.75, output incl. thinking 3.75, context caching 0.075, all introductory through 2026-12-31, rising from 2027-01-01 to input 1.50, output 7.50, caching 0.15. No separate '<=200k tokens' tier exists for Flash models; that tiering appears only on the Pro model. Cache write: the page publishes no per-token write price, only cache storage at 0.50 per 1M tokens per hour through 2026-12-31, then 1.00. Function calling: supported on the gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-3.6-flash model pages; the docs do not state it for the alias itself.

One tier: 0<Token<=1M input tokens per request. The pricing page does not split output price by thinking vs non-thinking. cache_write is 'Explicit Cache Creation' (0.2); cache_read is 'Explicit Cache Read' (0.016), and 'Input (Implicit Cache)' is also 0.016. The page does not show the dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com hostname; it states the region and scope only. Free quota 1M tokens for 90 days. The US scope is priced the same; the other regions are cheaper (0.113 / 0.382). Function calling: Supported in Singapore (International) per the model info page. Note that the separate function-calling guide's 'Supported models' list names Qwen3.7, 3.6, 3.5 and base Flash series but not Qwen3.8-Flash, so only the model info page confirms it.
